::: {#profile}

Hello! I'm Siyuan Yin, a student at Monash University with a background in econometrics and business analytics. I use R for data analysis and visualization, and enjoy turning research findings into clear, accessible data stories.

My latest blog post explores healthcare-associated infections in
Germany. It explains why hospital and population measures can tell
different stories about infection burden, and why infection counts
alone do not capture the full impact on health.

:::
